responsibility: This file implements the table renderer for grid and span-based text-art layouts. It manages table_cell_content sizing and painting, placement records and occupancy tracking for non-overlapping single cells and spans, two-pass computation of row heights and column widths, mapping from table coordinates to canvas coordinates via table_geometry, and painting of themed borders plus aligned cell contents into a canvas; it also includes comprehensive selftests for spans, alignment, missing cells, double-width characters, and complex layouts.
same_name_distinction: Implements table construction, occupancy tracking, geometry-driven painting, border connectivity, and related selftests; unlike gcc/text-art/table.h, it contains the rendering and sizing algorithms rather than the table type declarations.
